subject: Billing cutover & proposed Net45 + early-pay incentive for onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vantageframe.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: vantageprocurement@vantageframe.com
Date: 2026-10-11T09:02:00Z
Subject: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Hi Sofia / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood and need to align on vendor setup details. Two quick asks before we submit a PO:

1) Can Redwood process invoices on Net45 instead of your standard Net60 for the first 3 months? We can commit to an early-pay incentive (2% if paid within 15 days).
2) Which vendor onboarding documents do you need (W9, signed onboarding form, SOW)? We can attach.

We'll attach the onboarding packet once we confirm the billing cadence. Our procurement team is copied.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
VantageFrame Solutions

Attachments: none (will follow in reply)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vantageframe.com>, vantageprocurement@vantageframe.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-11T11:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Hi Liam — welcome, and excited to have VantageFrame onboard.

Short answers:
- We typically book new vendors on Net60. However, we can make an exception to move to Net45 for an initial trial period if Finance signs off. A 2% 15-day early-pay incentive is reasonable and will be escalated to Finance Ops for approval.
- Required docs: completed vendor onboarding form (attached), current W9, and the SOW or purchase schedule to tie invoices to the PO.

Can you return the signed onboarding form and W9 in one reply? I'll loop in Marissa (Finance Ops) and Aditya from AP so we can get a decision on the Net45 + early-pay. If approved, I'll create a custom PO note and route it for signature.

Next steps:
- Liam: send signed onboarding form + W9 + provisional SOW
- Marissa: confirm whether Finance can approve Net45 + 2%15
- Aditya: confirm PO routing and whether we need a separate billing contact

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_fillable.pdf (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-11T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Sofia / Aditya — investigating. Quick note from Finance Ops:

- We're open to approving Net45 for new vendors during an initial 60–90 day onboarding window provided there is an early-pay incentive. Standard approval: 2% if paid within 15 calendar days.
- Need to verify the invoice remit information and ensure the vendor can accept ACH (preferred) or provide wire details.
- If the SOW lists milestone-based invoicing, confirm acceptance criteria and billing schedule (we need invoice-to-PO line mapping).

I'll provisionally approve Net45 + 2%15 for the first 90 days on the condition we get the completed onboarding form, W9, and confirmation of banking details. I'll also require the vendor's email for AP invoices.

I'll attach a sample PO note we use for non-standard terms.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: non_standard_po_note_template.txt (stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vantageframe.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: vantageprocurement@vantageframe.com
Date: 2026-10-12T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Hi all — attaching the signed onboarding form and W9, plus a preliminary SOW and bank details for ACH. We can accept ACH (preferred) and provide remittance to accounting@vantageframe.com.

We accept the 2%15 early-pay incentive and appreciate the provisional Net45 onboarding window. Two clarifications:
- Can Redwood include the early-pay instruction on the PO ("2% if paid within 15 days")?
- For the initial quarter, can we request a one-time calibration invoice be paid within Net30 for the ramp milestone while the rest remain Net45? If not possible, we can include that milestone as Net45 with expedited processing.

Files attached: VantageFrame_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf, W9_VantageFrame.pdf, SOW_v1.xlsx, bank_details.txt

Best,
Liam

Attachments: VantageFrame_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf; W9_VantageFrame.pdf; SOW_v1.xlsx; bank_details.txt

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Looping in as a quick approval:

- Approve Net45 onboarding window, 2%/15 early-pay incentive approved for first 90 days.
- Finance: please add PO note: "Net45 onboarding trial; 2% discount if paid within 15 days; initial ramp milestone eligible for Net30 on request subject to AP confirmation."
- Aditya: please confirm the PO routing and whether we need a separate billing-only contact in Coupa/ERP. If so, ask VantageFrame to provide the billing contact and remit email (they provided accounting@vantageframe.com).

Sofia — once PO is created, please send the PO number to Liam and the DocuSign link for acceptance if needed.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations

Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment term flexibility + onboarding docs

Hi Liam — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments.

Status update:
- Finance has approved Net45 for a 90-day onboarding window with the 2%/15 early-pay incentive.
- PO has been created (PO-89234) and includes the custom PO note for non-standard terms. Link to PO: https://redwood.gd/procurement/PO-89234
- DocuSign envelope sent for signature to the primary contact on the onboarding form: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456

Action items for VantageFrame:
1) Sign DocuSign envelope to acknowledge PO and billing terms.
2) Confirm billing email for invoice submission (we have accounting@vantageframe.com).
3) If you want the initial ramp milestone paid Net30, flag that in the signature comment and we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

Once the DocuSign is complete, Aditya will attach the PO to your account and AP will be authorized to begin processing invoices under the Net45 terms.

Welcome aboard — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (PO and DocuSign links above)
